name: Gladia free credit
amount: €50 of credit, one-time (about 80 hours of pre-recorded transcription)
summary: Gladia gives a one-time €50 credit for its speech-to-text API, which it puts at roughly 80+ hours of pre-recorded or 60+ hours of real-time transcription. Often still described online as 10 free hours a month; its pricing page says there is no monthly reset.
source_note: gladia.io/pricing ("50€ in free credits, a one-time grant with no monthly reset"), checked 2026-10-03.
